notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/]Union of Gnomes: Prologue[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Emerge victorious from a string of the bloodiest medieval wars!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jpdNAPm.gif[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1]

 • 4 historical scenarios
 • Warfare in Italy, Spain, Britain, and Rus’
 • Seven centuries worth of feudal wars

This new update of Strategy & Tactics: Wargame Collection includes a set of single-player scenarios focused on medieval wars. Here you have an extensive range of options: whether to immerse yourself in the chaotic feuds of ancient Russian Princes, resolve a dispute between the most powerful European nations during the course of the Italian Wars, lead the Reconquista and drive the moors out of Spain, or even don Robin Hood’s cap!

notes.title: Mac OS Support and Huge, Free Expansion
notes.content:
[h1]Shape the future of the continent and the whole planet on a new Asian map!
[/h1]

[img]https://s9.postimg.org/nra5zjg0f/animation_asia_720.gif[/img]
The second update of Strategy & Tactics: Wargame Collection opens up new horizons and countries! The renewed Strategy & Tactics: Sandbox will be a sight for sore eyes for those who are tired of European battles. The new detailed Asian map expands the game’s geography by adding new counties such as Japan, China, and even Tibet. And our dynamic events system makes gameplay even more exciting!

[h1]Features:[/h1]

 • A vast Asian region including 17 countries 
 • 300 land-based and 150 marine locations
 • A new look for Asian Units

notes.title: Bring World War II to its conclusion as you command either Soviet or German forces!
notes.content:
The first update of Strategy & Tactics: Wargame Collection ends the World War II era with two historical campaigns for the USSR and Germany.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23895720/d0add7f25098085df26126c54f98e38e56259e77.png[/img]

Put Hitler's hordes to flight and raise your flag over the smoldering ruins of Berlin in the Victory Day campaign!

[img]https://s32.postimg.org/5njz0pwbp/FLAG.gif[/img]

Fight through fierce defensive battles at the frontiers of the collapsing Reich in the Twilight of the Gods campaign and seize your last chance to avoid unconditional surrender!

[list]
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[*][h1]End-of-WW2 historical campaigns for Germany and the USSR;[/h1]
[*][h1]Four historical scenario maps.[/h1]
[/list]

For those who like short but tactically intricate battles, we have added new single player scenarios dedicated to the beginning of World War II (“Exporter” and “Barbarossa”) and to its final, most dramatic episodes (“Race to Berlin” and “Soviet-Japanese War”).

:rstar:
